Spatial domain on the ICCAT 1x1 grid

Source: R/domain.R
om_domain_iccat.Rd

Builds the spatial domain of an ICCAT stock area from the grid bundled with the package (no GIS file needed). For stock_code = "BET-A" the result is identical to the domain of Experimento 02.

Usage

om_domain_iccat(
  stock_code = "BET-A",
  region_breaks = c(-20, 20),
  region_labels = c("R01", "R02", "R03"),
  geometry = TRUE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

stock_code

Stock area code (see iccat_stocks()).

region_breaks, region_labels

Latitudinal regions (see classify_regions()).

geometry

Attach the cell polygons (sf), used by the maps.

verbose

Print progress messages.

Value

An object of class om_domain.

Examples

dom <- om_domain_iccat("BET-A", geometry = FALSE)
#>   domain BET-A: 10051 cells | lattice 130 x 140
dom
#> <pelagicOM spatial domain> BET-A (iccat)
#>   10051 cells | lattice 130 x 140 | lon -97.4 to 41.3 | lat -59.5 to 69.9
#>   regions: R01 = 4519, R02 = 2368, R03 = 3164 
#>   total area: 88,756,675 km2 | geometry: no 
## the three regions of Experimento 02
table(dom$cells$Region)
#> 
#>  R01  R02  R03 
#> 4519 2368 3164
